name: Paragliding über Innsbruck
beschreibung:
This refers to a tandem paragliding flight over Innsbruck, where guest and tandem pilot take to the air together. Innsbruck is the capital of Tyrol and lies in the Inn Valley; north of the city rises the Nordkette mountain range, which is accessed by the Nordkettenbahnen cable cars. Paragliding flights over the city start from the Seegrube at 1,905 m depending on conditions and are possible year-round according to the Nordkette; landing usually takes place in the valley, often in the Arzl district. The experience is weather-dependent.

Various operators offer tandem paragliding in and around Innsbruck; a single company cannot be clearly identified from this entry.
